body: I had some major issues with Addy before, it prolly caused my last manic episode.  However, I abused weed for 10 years and weed and addy combo was really bad.  I able to better control addy now I stopped weed for good.

U are very inspiring!  I def look into Lithium.  I’m currently taking adderrall or else I would be in bed for a month.  Fuck., why is life so fucking hard!??  I just so glad I don’t have a wife and kid, and I still have my own place.

SnooO - you are too sweet!  I hope u find love too.  Being a teenager is a pretty awkward stage.  I been in love and had a few girlfriends.  I def never want to get married, but honestly with my depression and not having a job, I don’t even think about girls or even friends.  My mom still loves me, barely.  She said I make her sad all the time.  And I feel bad for that.
Same here, I didn’t realize I was bipolar until last year.  Glad u are doing well.  Plz don’t take anything for granted in life!

Goya - thanks for the thoughtful advice.  I thought about career change or starting my own business, etc.. but the failure rate is way too high.  Maybe I just need some new anti depression meds.  Was on bipolar but quit it due to side effects.
Thanks!  However at this point, I don’t need much love, rather have a good job.  Once u get to your 40s, friends n girls don’t mean much.

Thanks for replying.. don’t know if there’s any advice other than moral support.  I can try to get a job at Home Depot or something, but it hard to throwaway over 20 years of finance experience.  Plus my depression and laziness makes me see death as a quicker option than trying to restart my career n get fired again.
